integration_recommendation: Add the 2013 and 2014 observations to the existing US_mapping_2017 series. They are source-native rows from the already cited 2017 report and create a genuine 2013-2015 three-observation mapping series. Keep the existing 2016 total as an explicit reporting-universe break: it uses the wider C-2 universe, while E-1/E-2 exclude locations lacking founding-year data.

Add US_legacy_siwek_all_establishments as a distinct non-index-eligible series with 2009 and 2012 only. It is the best exact pre-2013 national direct-employment pair found, but its estimation method and firm universe differ from ESA Mapping Project data.
Optionally retain the 5+ establishment pair for audit context; do not plot it alongside the all-establishment pair as though it were one series.
Do not ingest BLS CES Software publishers values into a game-employment chart. CES is authoritative and long-running, but its NAICS scope includes non-game software publishers.
